$comment: Prompt manifest for tools/gen-art.mjs. Output: assets/art/<id>.png. Style keys keep 40 images in two coherent looks. `reference` = ids of already-generated images to use as style anchors (edits endpoint). See docs/art-pipeline.md.

garden.prefix: Whimsical storybook illustration for a cheerful card game. Painterly, soft edges, warm sunlit colours (buttery yellow, leaf green, cream, sky blue). Subject is a cute, friendly CYBORG garden creature: visible brass gears, tiny glass lenses, springs and copper wire integrated into its body, gentle happy expression. Centered, full body, clean silhouette, no text, no border.

thicket.prefix: Grim, realistic painted illustration for a folk-horror card game: photobashed painterly texture, low-key lighting, heavy film grain, desaturated palette of near-black greens, umber and bruised purple, a single cold rim light and a faint warm spill from the front. The creature is diseased and wrong: mangy wet matted fur, patches of bare greasy skin, visible ribs, crusted eyes that glow amber, joints that bend one time too many. Gross, never gory. Centered, full body, no text, no border.

scene.prefix: Wide painterly environment for a card game table scene. Foreground is a bright, sunlit storybook garden of flowers, moss and pebbles; with depth it turns into grim painted realism: wet black soil, tangled roots, thorns, cobwebs and shadow where faint amber eyes watch. Heavy film grain on the far half only, vignette, no characters, no text.

assets.prompt: A small cyborg earthworm named Wormillion: segmented pink body with a brass cap on its head, one round glass lens for an eye, a tiny spring tail, smiling.
A gaunt rat crouched low, fur matted, ribs showing, long naked tail curling behind, eyes glowing amber.
Wormillion, a cheerful cyborg earthworm: segmented pink body, brass head cap, single glass lens eye, spring tail, rearing up proudly.

A cyborg ladybug, red enamel shell with seven brass-rimmed spots, one spot is a tiny lens, wings half open, mid take-off.
A cyborg butterfly with stained-glass wings held in a fine brass frame, clockwork antennae, hovering, radiant.

Sir Reginald V: the same cyborg cat now wearing a black top hat and a gold monocle over its robotic eye, dignified and unimpressed.
A gaunt rat crouched low, fur matted, ribs showing, long naked tail, eyes glowing amber, baring yellow teeth.

A spindly spider with legs too long and jointed one time too many, eight amber eyes, strands of web trailing from it.
A scorpion of black chitin with a tail raised high, venom bead glowing faintly green at the sting, amber eyes.

A huge hairy wolf spider, forelegs raised, fangs dripping, eight amber eyes in two rows, cloaked in web.

A friendly elderly cyborg snail carrying a tiny wooden market stall on its shell, lanterns hanging from the awning, wearing spectacles.
The view across a garden table toward the woods: sunlit foreground of flowers and moss, fading into a dark thicket in the distance.
